name: Inkwave
author: dev-du-futur, after Inkwave by Jayden Davis
description: Turf War in blocky 3D: you and 3 bots against 4 bots for 3 minutes on Tidewater Plaza. Ink the ground, swim through your ink as a squid, splat the other team. Spritzer, Swell Roller or Glint Charger, plus bombs. Based on Inkwave (MIT).
